how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, the named suite run against it, then the file restored before the next row (X14/X15's convention: `before` is the shipped source the row was run against and `after` the text that replaced it, so every `before` is findable verbatim in `file` at 5f5c2e5f). Device rows ran on lease E1-uivzs, pair-a (emulator-5574 + iOS 27 `nitro-ui A`, Metro 8295), on 2026-11-05; every filtered run is recorded under its own name and satisfies nothing else. The last row is not a mutation: it is the same check run against the row E1 replaced, recorded because it is the measurement behind the `segmented-control.md` claim that the semantics did not move.
